page.content:
Divine shield-cloak that bears Medusa's head.

How Aegis connects

  • Character: Athena — Athena bears the aegis with Medusa's head.
  • Character: Medusa — Perseus' slaying of Medusa supplies the Gorgoneion on the aegis.

What is Aegis?

The aegis is the terrifying mantle of Zeus and Athena, often shown with the Gorgoneion. It is a working emblem of Olympian protection and panic in battle.

Key threads lead to Athena and Medusa.
